name: core-freezes-and-sign-offs
description: Constants' fields that move one way (oneWay), StateRules' subjects who may change a frozen field (by), and Approvals' gates whose sign-offs a change of chosen fields consumes (resetOn) and that pin the version their signer read (pinned), D104: cases written by hand in the recorded format, since the engine, which refuses each of them, recorded none. Each answer holds what the replayer compares: a record's id, data and behaviors, an operation's result, and a refusal whole, in the core's words; what only the engine's store answers (sequence numbers, versions, timestamps, the document a define echoes) is left out. A type's uses list the ones a table implements (Constants, StateRules, Approvals) before its Workflow, as a table lists them; a type that reads its creator declares createdBy.
